subject: Three-account demo — align one group slot (APAC/US overlap)

From: Sung Park <sung@openretail.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: group demo for three teams — can we find one slot?

Hi Karthik + Lauren,

We run a couple of engineering spikes next month and three of our groups (Retail Platform, Merchant APIs, and Personalization) would like a single group walkthrough of Redwood Inference focused on latency/cost settings and deploying in a VPC. Instead of three separate demos, could we try to consolidate into one 60-minute session that hits the common pieces + 15m for breakout Q&A?

High-level asks:
- Short architecture overview (15m)
- Serving runtime + batching demo (20m)
- Private deployment + security + SSO (15m)
- Breakouts by team (10m)

Our rough availability (PDT):
- Tue Jul 6: 10:00–12:00 or 15:30–17:30
- Wed Jul 7: 08:00–11:00 (we have folks in ANZ joining)
- Thu Jul 8: 12:00–16:00

Can you propose one slot that works for Redwood and whoever will own the demo? Also, if you prefer one of us to circulate the invite, let me know.

Thanks,
Sung
Sung Park
Head of Platform Engineering, OpenRetail

Subject: Re: Quick: group demo for three teams — can we find one slot?

Sung — thanks for consolidating the ask, this makes total sense. Happy to run a single 60-minute session plus breakouts. Proposing three candidate slots (I tried to pick overlap windows for APAC + PDT):

Option A — Tue Jul 6, 16:00–17:00 PDT / Wed Jul 7, 08:00–09:00 AEST (works for ANZ)
Option B — Wed Jul 7, 09:00–10:00 PDT / Thu Jul 8, 01:00–02:00 AEST (narrow overlap; will require ANZ to accept late hour)
Option C — Thu Jul 8, 12:30–13:30 PDT / Fri Jul 9, 04:30–05:30 AEST

If none of those work we can split to two 45m sessions but first preference is one group slot. Attached is a quick agenda and a pre-demo checklist so your teams can drop in any questions ahead of time.

Logistics notes:
- We'll host on a single Zoom bridge with breakout rooms for the last 10m.
- Vanessa will handle the demo tech run (screen + model sampling).
- Lauren will lead the security/Private deployment segment.

Sung — please reply with preferred option (A/B/C) and which attendees will join each breakout. Once you confirm I’ll create the calendar invite and include the Zoom link + pre-reads.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
